basis: Spastic ataxia reflects central neurologic dysfunction; gaze abnormalities and dysphagia are neurologic manifestations without established ocular or GI damage.
Defining abnormalities involve eyelids, hair and anus; eyelid coloboma and hair abnormalities occur in 80-99%, and anal abnormalities in 30-79%.
Defined by impaired gallbladder or biliary sphincter function; gallbladder and bile ducts belong to the hepatic axis.
Malignant smooth-muscle tumor originating in the small intestine; histology does not establish locomotor muscle involvement or an infectious cause.
Defining skin, nail and dental defects; sensorineural hearing loss in 3/6; esophageal strictures in 2/6 already GI. Asthma in 3/6 lacks established direct attribution.
Human calicivirus disease predominantly causes intestinal infection and gastroenteritis; animal manifestations do not establish human organ involvement.
Developmental delay and intellectual disability are common defining manifestations; no additional organ damage is established across this variable duplication group.
Thyroid hormone resistance defines the endocrine disorder; speech/language developmental delay reported in 2/2 supports neurologic involvement, with limited sampling.
Hereditary excess immunoglobulin G1 indicates an immune-system abnormality; absent definition and phenotype data prevent confident additional assignments.
Disease located in the glossopharyngeal cranial nerve; swallowing or taste manifestations do not establish separate organ damage.
Intellectual developmental disorder and distal skeletal defects define the syndrome; developmental delay occurs in 16/16 and intellectual disability in 13/13.
Benign cystic neoplasm originating in and occupying the kidney.
Dental caries directly destroys tooth hard tissue in pits and fissures; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Autonomous gonadal hormone production causes precocious puberty; accelerated skeletal maturation and reduced height do not establish destructive skeletal disease.
Defined by depletion of circulating granulocytes; infection susceptibility does not itself establish an infectious or immune-mediated cause.
Neuroepithelial tumor originating within the CNS ventricular system.
Dysraphic lipomatous malformation attached to the spinal cord; associated vertebral abnormalities lack evidence of frequency sufficient for another axis.
Reflex epilepsy with seizures triggered by cognitive tasks; the defining dysfunction is cerebral.
GALT metabolic defect with defining neonatal liver disease; neurologic abnormalities 80-99%, cataracts 30-79%. Coagulopathy omitted at four-axis cap.
Progressive retinal and choroidal atrophy directly causes visual loss; associated cataracts remain within the ocular axis.
Pancreatic and salivary acinar carcinomas map to GI. Site-unspecified histologic umbrella also includes prostate and breast primaries, limiting organ certainty.
Defined by clot formation within vessels or heart chambers; systemic coagulation disease is not required, and downstream organ injury varies by site.
Inherited disruption of neutral amino acid transport defines an inborn metabolic disorder; no common additional organ damage is established for the umbrella.
Generalized loss of subcutaneous and visceral adipose tissue defines a skin/subcutis and metabolic disorder; diabetes and fatty liver are separate diagnoses.
Squamous carcinoma originating in nasal cavity mucosa; the nasal airway belongs to the pulmonary axis.
